    if p15Parent then
        p15Parent = p15.Parent.Name:lower()
    end

    local v85 = p15Parent or ""
    local v86 = p15:GetFullName():lower()
    local v87 = v83:find("hide")

    if not v87 then
        v87 = v83:find("sleep")

        if not v87 then
            v87 = v85:find("hide")

            if not v87 then
                v87 = v85:find("sleep")
            end
        end
    end

    if v87 then
        return false
    end

    local TaskBreaker = t2.value14.TaskBreaker

    if TaskBreaker then
        TaskBreaker = t2.value14.TaskBreaker.Value

        if TaskBreaker then
            TaskBreaker = v83:find("breaker")

            if not TaskBreaker then
                TaskBreaker = v86:find("breaker")
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskBreaker then
        return true
    end

    local TaskTrash = t2.value14.TaskTrash

    if TaskTrash then
        TaskTrash = t2.value14.TaskTrash.Value

        if TaskTrash then
            TaskTrash = v83:find("trash")

            if not TaskTrash then
                TaskTrash = v86:find("trash")
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskTrash then
        return true
    end

    local TaskCat = t2.value14.TaskCat

    if TaskCat then
        TaskCat = t2.value14.TaskCat.Value

        if TaskCat then
            TaskCat = v83:find("food")

            if not TaskCat then
                TaskCat = v83:find("water")

                if not TaskCat then
                    TaskCat = v86:find("catbowl")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskCat then
        return true
    end

    local TaskCurtains = t2.value14.TaskCurtains

    if TaskCurtains then
        TaskCurtains = t2.value14.TaskCurtains.Value

        if TaskCurtains then
            TaskCurtains = v83:find("curtain")

            if not TaskCurtains then
                TaskCurtains = v86:find("curtain")
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskCurtains then
        return true
    end

    local TaskFlyers = t2.value14.TaskFlyers

    if TaskFlyers then
        TaskFlyers = t2.value14.TaskFlyers.Value

        if TaskFlyers then
            TaskFlyers = v83:find("flyer")

            if not TaskFlyers then
                TaskFlyers = v83:find("paper")

                if not TaskFlyers then
                    TaskFlyers = v86:find("paper") or v86:find("flyer")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskFlyers then
        return true
    end

    local TaskPlants = t2.value14.TaskPlants

    if TaskPlants then
        TaskPlants = t2.value14.TaskPlants.Value

        if TaskPlants then
            TaskPlants = v83:find("plant")

            if not TaskPlants then
                TaskPlants = v86:find("plant")
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskPlants then
        return true
    end

    local TaskClock = t2.value14.TaskClock

    if TaskClock then
        TaskClock = t2.value14.TaskClock.Value

        if TaskClock then
            TaskClock = v83:find("clock") or v86:find("clock")
        end
    end

    if TaskClock then
        return true
    end

    local TaskLights = t2.value14.TaskLights

    if TaskLights then
        TaskLights = t2.value14.TaskLights.Value

        if TaskLights then
            TaskLights = v83:find("light") or v86:find("light")
        end
    end

    if TaskLights then
        return true
    end

    local TaskPhone = t2.value14.TaskPhone

    if TaskPhone then
        TaskPhone = t2.value14.TaskPhone.Value

        if TaskPhone then
            TaskPhone = v83:find("phone")

            if not TaskPhone then
                TaskPhone = v86:find("telephone")
            end
        end
    end

    if TaskPhone then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

        end
    end

    return n1
end

v31:AddToggle("FlyToggle", {
	Text = "Fly (Flight Mode)",
	Default = false,
	Tooltip = "Allows you to fly around freely (WASD + Space/Shift)"
})
t2.value14.FlyToggle:OnChanged(function(p21)
    t2.value26 = p21

    local Character = t2.value10.Character

    if Character then
        Character = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    if t2.value26 then
        t2.value27 = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        t2.value27.Name = "UltraFlyVel"
        t2.value27.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1000000000, 1000000000, 1000000000)
        t2.value27.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        t2.value27.Parent = Character
        t2.value28 = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        t2.value28.Name = "UltraFlyGyro"
        t2.value28.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1000000000, 1000000000, 1000000000)
        t2.value28.P = 90000
        t2.value28.CFrame = Character.CFrame
        t2.value28.Parent = Character
        task.spawn(function()
            local CurrentCamera = t2.value8.CurrentCamera
            local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

            while true do
                local value26 = t2.value26

                if value26 then
                    value26 = t2.value27

                    if value26 then
                        value26 = t2.value27.Parent
                    end
                end

                if not value26 then
                    break
                end

                local zero = Vector3.zero

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                    zero += CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                end

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                    zero -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                end

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                    zero -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
                end

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                    zero += CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
                end

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                    zero += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                end

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                    zero -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                end

                t2.value27.Velocity = zero * t2.value25
                t2.value28.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame
                task.wait()
            end
        end)

        return
    end

    if t2.value27 then
        t2.value27:Destroy()
    end

    if t2.value28 then
        t2.value28:Destroy()
    end
end)

function t2.value32(p32, p33)
    if not p32 or t2.value30[p32] then
        return
    end

    local v166 = p32:IsA("Model")

    if v166 then
        v166 = p32.PrimaryPart

        if not v166 then
            v166 = p32:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
        end
    end

    local v167 = v166 or p32
    local v168 = not v167

    if not v168 then
        v168 = not v167:IsA("BasePart")
    end

    if v168 then
        return
    end

    local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

    BillboardGui.Name = "AnomalyRadarLabel"
    BillboardGui.Adornee = v167
    BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
    BillboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true

    local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TextLabel.Text = "⚠\239\184\143 ANOMALY: " .. p33
    TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
    TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    TextLabel.TextSize = 18
    TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
    BillboardGui.Parent = v167
    t2.value30[p32] = BillboardGui

function t2.value33()
    for _, v in pairs(t2.value30) do
        if v and v.Parent then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

function t2.value34()
    local t3 = {}

    for _, descendant in ipairs(t2.value8:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            local descendantName = descendant.Name
            local v163 = descendantName:find("Ghost")

            if not v163 then
                v163 = descendantName:find("Wendigo")

                if not v163 then
                    v163 = descendantName:find("Shadow")

                    if not v163 then
                        v163 = descendantName:find("FakeFriend")

                        if not v163 then
                            v163 = descendantName:find("Anomaly")

                            if not v163 then
                                v163 = descendantName:find("CarpetModel2")

                                if not v163 then
                                    v163 = descendantName:find("Trashcan2")

                                    if not v163 then
                                        v163 = descendantName:find("Plant2")
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if v163 then
                table.insert(t3, {
					instance = descendant,
					name = descendantName
				})
            end
        end
    end

    return t3
end

                    end

                    t2.value32(v.instance, v.name)
                end

                table.clear(t2.value31)
            end

            task.wait(1.5)
        end
    end)
end)

local v38 = v24:AddLeftGroupbox("Shortcuts & Teleports")

function t2.value36(p35)
    if not p35 then
        return nil
    end

    if p35:IsA("BasePart") then
        return p35.CFrame
    end

    if p35:IsA("Model") then
        if p35.PrimaryPart then
            return p35.PrimaryPart.CFrame
        end

        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return p35:GetPivot()
        end)

        if ok and result then
            return result
        end

        local BasePart = p35:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

        if BasePart then
            return BasePart.CFrame
        end
    end

    return nil
end
t2.value37 = nil
function t2.value37(p36)
    if not p36 then
        return nil
    end

    local p36Position = p36.Position
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

    pcall(function()
        if Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude then
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

            return
        end

        if Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist then
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        end
    end)

    if t2.value10.Character then
        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { t2.value10.Character }
    end

    local raycastResult = t2.value8:Raycast(p36Position + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0), Vector3.new(0, -60, 0), raycastParams)

    if raycastResult then
        return CFrame.new(raycastResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
    end

    return p36 + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
end
function t2.value38(p37)
    if not p37 then
        return false
    end

    local Character = t2.value10.Character

    if not Character then
        return false
    end

    local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not HumanoidRootPart then
        return false
    end

    local v188 = t2.value37(p37)

    pcall(function()
        HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
        HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        Character:PivotTo(v188)
        HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = v188
    end)
    task.delay(0.4, function()
        local v270 = HumanoidRootPart

        if v270 then
            v270 = HumanoidRootPart.Parent
        end

        if v270 then
            HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
            HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end)

    return true
end
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        local Character = t2.value10.Character
        local v190 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if v190 then
            v190 = v190.Position.Y < -30
        end

        if v190 then
            local DoorBox = t2.value8:FindFirstChild("DoorBox")

            if not DoorBox then
                DoorBox = t2.value8:FindFirstChild("bed", true)
            end

            local v192 = t2.value36(DoorBox)

            if not v192 then
                v192 = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
            end

            t2.value38(v192)
            t2.value5("⚠\239\184\143 Anti-Void Triggered: Teleported back to Room!", 3)
        end
    end
end)
